Returns the default FastJsonOptions used to build a FastJson instance.Creates a new FastJson instance with the given FastJsonOptions.Returns the FastJsonDecodePath used to decode values of a given type. Every shape now decodes with the direct engine (borrowed shapes simply receive zero-copy string views). The fjdpSimd* values are retained for API compatibility and are no longer selected.Returns the FastJsonEngine used to decode values of a given type. Always fjeDirect; fjeSimdjson is retained for API compatibility after the simdjson C++ backend was removed.Serializes a value into a JSON string after validating FastJson options.Serializes a value directly into an existing string buffer.Serializes a value into a byte sequence.Serializes the value as JSON and writes the encoded string to the stream.Serializes the value as JSON into the in-memory string stream, replacing its buffer when empty.Deserializes JSON text into a value of type T with the pure-Nim direct engine; borrowed-string shapes receive zero-copy string views.Deserializes a JSON byte sequence into a value of type T.Reads the stream contents subject to the size limit and deserializes them into a value of type T.Returns true if the JSON text is syntactically valid and within the input size limit.Returns true if the byte sequence is syntactically valid JSON within the input size limit.Returns true if the stream contents form valid JSON within the input size limit.

Types

FastJson = ref object
  options*: FastJsonOptions ## True when every option that `validateDeserializeOptions` rejects is at
                            ## its default value, so the per-call option checks can be skipped.
  strictDefaults*: bool ## True when every option that `validateSerializeOptions` rejects is at
                        ## its default value, so the per-call option checks can be skipped.
  strictSerializeDefaults*: bool
FastJsonDecodePath = enum
  fjdpDirect, fjdpSimdLeaf, fjdpSimdNested, fjdpSimdBorrowed
FastJsonEngine = enum
  fjeDirect, fjeSimdjson
FastJsonEnumStyle = enum
  fjesString, fjesOrdinal
FastJsonFieldNamingPolicy = enum
  fjfnpPreserve, fjfnpCamelCase, fjfnpSnakeCase
FastJsonOptions = object
  indentOutput*: bool
  indentStep*: int
  escapeNonAscii*: bool
  omitNullFields*: bool
  omitDefaultFields*: bool
  fieldNamingPolicy*: FastJsonFieldNamingPolicy
  unknownFieldPolicy*: FastJsonUnknownFieldPolicy
  enumStyle*: FastJsonEnumStyle
  caseInsensitiveFields*: bool
  allowTrailingCommas*: bool
  allowComments*: bool
  allowSingleQuotes*: bool
  allowUnquotedFieldNames*: bool
  allowNumbersFromStrings*: bool
  allowSpecialFloats*: bool
  maxDepth*: int
  maxInputBytes*: int
  maxArrayItems*: int
  useSimdWhenAvailable*: bool
  preferBorrowedStrings*: bool
FastJsonUnknownFieldPolicy = enum
  fjufpIgnore, fjufpError
